exercises.instructionUz: Har bir xonada nima bor? 'There is / There are' bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI — 'there is' va 'there are':

  There IS a sofa in the living-room.       (BITTA narsa)
  There ARE some chairs in the dining-room. (KO'P narsa)

Qoida:
  • Birlik ot  → There is + A/AN + ot
  • Ko'plik ot → There are + SOME + ot(-s)

'some' — 'bir nechta' ma'nosida. Aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.

DIQQAT — a yoki an?
  a sofa, a table, a fridge   (undosh tovush bilan boshlansa)
  an armchair                 (unli tovush bilan boshlansa)

O'zbekchada 'mehmonxonada divan bor' deymiz — gap XONA bilan boshlanadi.
Inglizchada esa gap 'There is...' bilan BOSHLANADI, xona OXIRIDA keladi.
Bu tuzilma o'zbek tilida yo'q, shuning uchun ko'p mashq qilish kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT + OT birikmalari (collocations).

Ingliz tilida ba'zi sifatlar ma'lum otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
Masalan 'pretty' — kichik, nozik narsalar uchun: a pretty bedroom.
'Huge' esa juda katta narsalar uchun: a huge kitchen.

So'zni ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA holida yodlang — shunda tabiiy gapirasiz:
  ❌ 'beautiful' = chiroyli
  ✅ 'a beautiful garden' = chiroyli bog'

Matn A dan: lovely house, huge kitchen, spacious living-room,
            beautiful garden
Matn B dan: attractive flat, quiet street, pleasant area,
            pretty bedroom, modern kitchen, comfortable living-room,
            wonderful view, large garage

exercises.explanationUz:

Kitobda birinchi harf va harflar soni berilgan:
  big       = huge, s________, l_____
  beautiful = attractive, p______
  pleasant  = l______, w_________

Nega bir necha so'z kerak? Chunki bir so'zni takrorlab yozish
zerikarli. Yozma ishda sinonim ishlatish — yuqori daraja belgisi.

Ottenkalar:
  big      — oddiy 'katta'
  huge     — juda katta, ulkan
  large    — katta (big bilan deyarli bir xil, rasmiyroq)
  spacious — keng, joyi ko'p (xona uchun)

  beautiful  — go'zal (kuchli maqtov)
  attractive — jozibali
  pretty     — chiroyli (kichik narsalar uchun)

  pleasant  — yoqimli
  lovely    — yoqimli, shirin (og'zaki nutqda ko'p)
  wonderful — ajoyib (juda kuchli)

tasks.en: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre, and is near the shops and the main road.

tasks.uz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
tasks.note: quite = ancha, but = lekin, very = juda.

tasks.uz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor, har birida kiyim shkafi va hammom bor.

tasks.en: There is also a study with a big bookcase.

tasks.note: also = ham, yana. 'There is' — birlik, bitta study.

exercises.explanationUz:

Har birida -s yoki -es tanlashingiz kerak.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida ko'plik OT OXIRIGA qo'shimcha qo'shib yasaladi.
O'zbekchada '-lar', inglizchada '-s' yoki '-es'.

Qaysi biri qo'shilishi otning OXIRGI HARFIGA bog'liq.

rules.enRule: Most nouns take -s in the plural.
examples: chair → chairs
room → rooms
wall → walls
table → tables

rules.enRule: Nouns ending in -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o take -es in the plural.
examples: address → addresses
bus → buses
brush → brushes
bench → benches
box → boxes
tomato → tomatoes

rule.noteUz:
NEGA -es? Chunki 's' tovushidan keyin yana 's' aytib bo'lmaydi.
  bus + s = 'bass' — eshitilmaydi
  bus + es = 'BAS-iz' — eshitiladi
Ya'ni -es qo'shimchasi TALAFFUZ uchun kerak. Uni /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ 3 xil bo'ladi:
  /s/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: books, cats, desks
  /z/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: rooms, walls, chairs
  /iz/ — s, ss, sh, ch, x, ge dan keyin: buses, brushes, benches

Bu farqni yozuvda ko'rsatmaydi, lekin gapirishda muhim.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir raqamda IKKITA rasm bor: birinchisi YAQIN (this/these),
ikkinchisi UZOQ (that/those).

Namuna: This is a sofa and that is a table.

Qadam-qadam:
  1) Birinchi narsa bittami? → This is a ...
     Ko'pmi?              → These are ...
  2) Ikkinchi narsa bittami? → that is a ...
     Ko'pmi?               → those are ...

DIQQAT: gap o'rtasidagi 'that/those' KICHIK harf bilan yoziladi.
Va 'and' dan oldin vergul qo'yilmaydi.

tasks.speakAnswer: This is a cooker and that is a fridge.

rule.explanationUz:
To'rt so'z ikki narsani bir vaqtda ko'rsatadi:
  1) YAQINMI yoki UZOQMI?
  2) BITTAMI yoki KO'PMI?

              BITTA (singular)   KO'P (plural)
  YAQIN (near)   this              these
  UZOQ  (far)    that              those

O'zbekchada: bu / bular, u / ular — deyarli bir xil tizim.

rules.enRule: We use this/these for things near us.
examples: This is a chair.
These are chairs.

rules.enRule: We use that/those for things far from us.
examples: That is a clock.
Those are clocks.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — fe'lni unutish:
  ❌ This a chair.        ✅ This IS a chair.
  ❌ These is chairs.     ✅ These ARE chairs.

is/are ko'rsatish olmoshiga qarab tanlanadi:
  this / that  → IS
  these / those → ARE
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ farqi:
  this  /ðɪs/  — qisqa 'i'
  these /ðiːz/ — cho'ziq 'ii' va oxirida 'z'
Ikkalasi juda o'xshash eshitiladi, shuning uchun ot ko'plikmi-yo'qmi
ekaniga qarab ham tushunish mumkin.

rule.explanationUz:
Bu tuzilma 'BIROR JOYDA NIMADIR BOR' deyish uchun ishlatiladi.
'There' bu yerda 'u yerda' degani EMAS — u shunchaki gapni boshlash uchun
turadigan so'z. Tarjima qilinmaydi.

  There is a bed in the bedroom.  — Yotoqxonada karavot bor.
  (so'zma-so'z: 'bor bitta karavot yotoqxonada')

keyRules.enRule: We use there is in the singular.
examples: There is a bed in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use there are in the plural.
examples: There are two beds in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use some in the plural in the affirmative.
examples: There are some chairs in the kitchen.

keyRules.uzRule: Ko'plik + INKOR va SAVOL gapda — ANY.
keyRules.enRule: We use any in the plural in the negative and interrogative.
examples: There aren't any chairs in the kitchen.
Are there any chairs in the kitchen?

rule.warningUz:
SOME yoki ANY?
  ✅ There are SOME chairs.        (tasdiq)
  ✅ There aren't ANY chairs.      (inkor)
  ✅ Are there ANY chairs?         (savol)
  ❌ There aren't some chairs.
  ❌ Are there some chairs?

Oson eslash: 'some' — faqat TASDIQDA. Qolgan ikkisida 'any'.
rule.noteUz:
Qisqartmalar:
  there is not  = there isn't
  there are not = there aren't
Og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

Savolda so'z tartibi ALMASHADI:
  There is a bed. → IS THERE a bed?
  There are beds. → ARE THERE any beds?

exercises.explanationUz:
Kitob betidagi rasmda: table, vase, flowers, magazine, ball,
chair, plant, poster, carpet.

Matn: 'There is a table in the room. There is a vase (1) in/on the table
with some flowers (2) in/on it. There is a magazine (3) under/in front of
the vase. There is a ball (4) behind/under the table. There is a chair
(5) next to/under the table. There is a plant (6) behind/in front of the
chair. There is a poster (7) on/in the wall (8) next to/under the plant.'

Har bir raqamda rasmga qarang va narsa qayerda turganini toping.

tasks.prompt: There is a vase (1) ____ the table.
tasks.whyUz: Guldon stol USTIDA turibdi. 'in the table' — stolning ichida degani bo'lardi, bu ma'nosiz.
Gullar guldon ICHIDA. 'it' — bu yerda 'the vase'.

tasks.prompt: There is a magazine (3) ____ the vase.
tasks.whyUz: Jurnal stol ustida, guldonning OLDIDA yotibdi — ostida emas.

tasks.prompt: There is a ball (4) ____ the table.
There is a chair (5) ____ the table.
There is a plant (6) ____ the chair.
There is a poster (7) ____ the wall...
tasks.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsalar uchun doim ON ishlatiladi.

rule.titleUz: ON / IN / UNDER / BEHIND / NEXT TO / IN FRONT OF
rule.explanationUz:
Predlog — narsaning QAYERDA ekanini ko'rsatadigan so'z.
O'zbekchada bu qo'shimcha bo'ladi (stol-DA, stol-NING ostida),
ingliz tilida esa ALOHIDA so'z va otdan OLDIN turadi.

  ✅ on the table   (stol ustida)
  ❌ the table on

Kitobdagi rasm: ko'k kvadrat — narsa, pushti doira — biz gapirayotgan buyum.

rules.enRule: on = on top of / touching the surface
examples: The vase is on the table.
There is a poster on the wall.
The carpet is on the floor.

rules.enRule: in = inside
examples: The flowers are in the vase.
The table is in the room.

rules.enRule: under = below
examples: The ball is under the table.
There is a bedside table under the poster.

rules.enRule: behind = at the back of
examples: The plant is behind the chair.
Behind the bed there are two windows.

rules.enRule: next to = beside
examples: The chair is next to the table.
There is a lamp next to the bed.

rules.enRule: in front of = at the front of
examples: The magazine is in front of the vase.
There is a table in front of the sofa.

rule.warningUz:
ON va IN chalkashtiriladi:
  on the table  — stol USTIDA (tegib turibdi)
  in the table  — noto'g'ri! stolning ICHIDA degani bo'lardi

  in the vase   — guldon ICHIDA (gullar)
  on the vase   — guldon USTIDA (bu boshqa ma'no)

Devor uchun doim ON: 'a poster ON the wall' (in the wall EMAS).
Devorda tuynuk bo'lsagina 'in the wall' deyiladi.
rule.noteUz:
IN FRONT OF — uch so'zdan iborat, uchalasi ham kerak:
  ✅ in front of the chair
  ❌ in front the chair
  ❌ front of the chair

NEXT TO — ikki so'z, 'to' shart:
  ✅ next to the table
  ❌ next the table
rule.extraUz:
Predlogdan keyin OLMOSH kelsa, u OBYEKT shakliga o'tadi:
  on the table → on IT   (uning ustida)
  next to Jenny → next to HER
  behind the boys → behind THEM

Masalan: 'There is a vase on the table with some flowers IN IT.'
('it' = the vase)

Grammar Book bu qoidani Coursebook 20-betdagidan BATAFSILROQ beradi:
bu yerda ko'plik qo'shimchasining TALAFFUZI ham bor.

  Coursebook: -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o → -es
  Grammar:    -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x     → -es
Grammar Book '-o' ni sanamagan, lekin u ham -es oladi:
  tomato → tomatoes, potato → potatoes

rule.pluralNoteUz:

Ko'plik qo'shimchasi UCH XIL o'qiladi — bu yozuvda ko'rinmaydi,
lekin gapirishda muhim.

  /s/  — ot /f/, /k/, /θ/, /p/ yoki /t/ tovushi bilan tugasa
         books, clocks, cats

  /ɪz/ — ot /s/, /ks/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/ yoki /ʒ/ tovushi bilan tugasa
         torches, bridges, buses
         (bu holda qo'shimcha ALOHIDA bo'g'in bo'ladi!)

  /z/  — boshqa har qanday tovushdan keyin
         tables, sofas, mirrors
rule.extraUz:
NEGA shunday? Til o'zi qulaylikka moslashadi:
  • jarangsiz tovushdan keyin jarangsiz /s/ oson
  • jarangli tovushdan keyin jarangli /z/ oson
  • 's' tovushidan keyin yana 's' aytib bo'lmaydi — orasiga /ɪ/ qo'shiladi

O'zbek tilida ham shunga o'xshash hodisa bor: 'kitob' + 'lar',

exercises.instructionEn: Choose this, these, that or those.
exercises.instructionUz: this, these, that yoki those — birini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ikki savolga javob bering: YAQINMI-UZOQMI va BITTAMI-KO'PMI.

rule.explanationUz:
Grammar Book rasmlar bilan tushuntiradi:
  bitta soat  → This is a clock.
  ikkita soat → These are clocks.
  bitta quyon (uzoqda)  → That is a rabbit.
  ikkita quyon (uzoqda) → Those are rabbits.

              BITTA    KO'P
  YAQIN       this     these
  UZOQ        that     those

rules.uzRule: YAQINdagi odam, hayvon yoki narsani ko'rsatish uchun this/these.
rules.enRule: We use this/these to point to people, animals or things near us.
examples: This is a clock.
These are clocks.

rules.uzRule: UZOQdagi odam, hayvon yoki narsani ko'rsatish uchun that/those.
rules.enRule: We use that/those to point to people, animals or things far from us.
examples: That is a rabbit.
Those are rabbits.

rule.warningUz:
Fe'l ham o'zgaradi — buni unutmang:
  this / that   → IS   (birlik)
  these / those → ARE  (ko'plik)

  ❌ These is clocks.   ✅ These ARE clocks.
  ❌ Those is rabbits.  ✅ Those ARE rabbits.

Va ot ham ko'plikka o'tadi: clock → clockS, rabbit → rabbitS.
rule.noteUz:
Kitob 'people, animals or things' deydi — ya'ni bu olmoshlar
ODAMLAR uchun ham ishlatiladi:
  This is my brother.   — Bu mening akam.
  These are my friends. — Bular mening do'stlarim.

Tanishtirishda ham shu ishlatiladi: 'This is Ann.'

rule.titleUz: 'There is / There are' va qisqa javoblar
rule.explanationUz:
Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun.
  There IS  — bitta narsa
  There ARE — ko'p narsa

keyRules.enRule: We use there is in the singular.
examples: There is a desk in my room.

keyRules.enRule: We use there are in the plural.
examples: There are five books on my desk.

rule.noteUz:
QISQA JAVOB — kitobdagi 'Short answers' jadvali.

Qisqa javobda ot TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  ❌ Yes, there is a sofa.
  ✅ Yes, there is.

Va 'there' so'zi ham TUSHIB QOLMAYDI:
  ❌ Yes, it is.
  ✅ Yes, there is.

Savolda 'Is/Are' oldinga chiqadi:
  There is a sofa. → IS THERE a sofa?
  There are chairs. → ARE THERE any chairs?

rule.titleUz: some, any, a/an — qachon qaysi biri
rule.explanationUz:
Uchta so'z, uchta vazifa. Ikki savolga qarab tanlanadi:
  1) ot BIRLIKMI yoki KO'PLIKMI?
  2) gap TASDIQMI, INKORMI yoki SAVOLMI?

  BIRLIK  → a / an  (har uchala gapda ham)
  KO'PLIK + tasdiq → some
  KO'PLIK + inkor yoki savol → any

keyRules.uzRule: TASDIQ gapda ko'plik ot bilan — some.
keyRules.enRule: We use some in the affirmative with plural nouns.
examples: There are some chairs in the room.

keyRules.uzRule: INKOR yoki SAVOL gapda ko'plik ot bilan — any.
keyRules.enRule: We use any in the negative or interrogative with plural nouns.
examples: There aren't any pictures on the wall.
Are there any chairs in the room?

keyRules.uzRule: BIRLIK ot bilan — a/an (gap turidan qat'i nazar).
keyRules.enRule: We use a/an with singular nouns.
examples: There is a book on my desk.
There isn't an elephant in the zoo.
Is there a vase on the table?

rule.warningUz:
A yoki AN?
  a  — undosh TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: a book, a desk, a vase
  an — unli TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: an elephant, an armchair, an attic

HARF emas, TOVUSH muhim:
  an hour   (h o'qilmaydi, 'auer' deb boshlanadi)
  a university ('yuniversiti' — 'y' tovushi, undosh)
rule.extraUz:
Kitobdagi misolda diqqat qiling:
  'There ISN'T AN elephant in the zoo.'
Inkor gap, lekin ot BIRLIK — shuning uchun 'any' emas, 'an'.
Ya'ni 'any' faqat KO'PLIK bilan ishlatiladi.

rule.titleUz: on, in front of, under, behind, next to, in
rule.explanationUz:
Grammar Book oltita predlogni rasm bilan ko'rsatadi.
Har bir rasmni eslab qolsangiz, predlogni hech qachon adashtirmaysiz.

rules.enRule: on
examples: The cat is on the fence.
There is a carpet on the floor.

rules.enRule: in front of
examples: The man is in front of the bench.
There is a table in front of the sofa.

rules.enRule: under
examples: The dog is under the table.

rules.enRule: behind
examples: The magician is behind the table.

rules.enRule: next to

rules.enRule: in
examples: The dog is in the kennel.

rule.noteUz:
Kitobdagi rasmlar:
  on          — mushuk devor USTIDA uxlayapti
  in front of — erkak skameyka OLDIDA turibdi
  under       — kuchuk stol OSTIDA o'tiribdi
  behind      — sehrgar stol ORQASIDA turibdi
  next to     — erkak kompyuter YONIDA o'tiribdi
  in          — it uy ICHIDA (kataksida)
rule.warningUz:
IN FRONT OF — uch so'z, hammasi kerak:
  ✅ in front of the bench
  ❌ in front the bench

NEXT TO — 'to' shart:
  ✅ next to the computer
  ❌ next the computer

IN va ON:
  in the box   — quti ICHIDA
  on the box   — quti USTIDA

SAVOLLAR RO'YXATI (oltitasi ham ishlatiladi):
  How many rooms has it got?  — Nechta xonasi bor?
  Where is it?                — U qayerda?
  When can I see it?          — Uni qachon ko'rsam bo'ladi?
  What's it like?             — U qanaqa?
  Is there a garden?          — Bog'i bormi?

  javob joy haqida bo'lsa   → Where is it?

MUHIM IBORA — 'What's it like?'

  What's it like? = U qanaqa? Uni tasvirlab bering.
Javobi sifat bilan beriladi: 'It's a big house.'

TELEFONDA:

  Who's speaking?     — Kim gapiryapti?
  Ms — turmush qurgan yoki qurmaganini bildirmaydigan murojaat

wordFormation.explanationUz: Xona nomi ko'pincha 'nima uchun ishlatilishi' + room shaklida. Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
Jihoz nomlari ham qo'shma. Birinchi so'z QAYERDA yoki NIMA UCHUN ekanini aytadi.
Kundalik nutqda uzun so'zlar qisqaradi. Qisqasi ko'proq ishlatiladi.
Bu farqlar xato manbai bo'ladi.
Fe'l yoki otga -ive qo'shilib sifat yasaladi. Ma'nosi: 'shu xususiyatga ega'.
Otga -ful qo'shilsa 'shunga to'la' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi. DIQQAT: bitta 'l' bilan yoziladi!
Fe'l yoki otga -able qo'shiladi.
Uy tavsifida doim juft bo'lib keladi.
Fe'l va ot bir xil yoziladi, lekin gapda vazifasi boshqa.
Otning shakli o'zgarmaydi, oxiriga -s qo'shiladi.
Bu tovushlardan keyin -s eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun -es qo'shiladi va /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
Bu so'zlar ham birlik/ko'plikka qarab o'zgaradi — ot kabi -s olmaydi, butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.
not so'zi fe'lga qo'shilib qisqaradi. Apostrof (') tushib qolgan 'o' o'rnida turadi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Bir so'zli va ko'p so'zli predloglar
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ba'zi predloglar bitta so'z, ba'zilari 2–3 so'zdan iborat. Ko'p so'zli predloglar BUTUN holda yodlanadi — bir bo'lagini tashlab bo'lmaydi.
Ega olmoshi predlogdan keyin OBYEKT shakliga o'tadi.
'Where is ...?' savoliga javob berganda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

items.note: MUTLAQO boshqa so'z! its = egalik, it's = it is

wordFormation.ruleUz: Qo'shma so'z bilan yasalgan uy turlari
wordFormation.explanationUz: Uy turi ko'pincha MATERIAL yoki JOY + uy so'zidan yasaladi.

items.note: fransuz tilidan; o'qilishi 'SHA-ley', oxirgi t o'qilmaydi

wordFormation.explanationUz: Narsa nimadan yasalganini aytish uchun 'be made of' ishlatiladi.
Qavat raqami TARTIB SON bilan aytiladi va oldiga 'the' qo'yiladi.
Manzil yozganda ko'cha turi qisqartiriladi va nuqta qo'yiladi.
E'londa joy tejash uchun artikl (a/the) va 'to be' fe'li tushib qoladi. Siz o'qiyotganda ularni tiklashingiz kerak.

items.base: Lovely house five miles from city centre

wordFormation.ruleUz: double / single — son bildiruvchi oldi qo'shimchalar
wordFormation.explanationUz: Narsaning nechta kishi yoki nechta buyum uchun ekanini bildiradi.

items.derived: a double bed / a single bed
a double room / a single room

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ko'p sifatlar -er va -est oladi, lekin 'good' butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.
Ijara e'lonlarida takror uchraydigan so'zlar.
Yozuvda bir xil (-s / -es), lekin og'zaki nutqda uch xil o'qiladi.
Artikl keyingi so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarab tanlanadi, harfiga emas.
Bir xil ma'no ('bir nechta'), lekin gap turiga qarab almashadi.
Ot shakli o'zgarmaydi, oxiriga -s qo'shiladi.
Oxirgi tovush 's' ga o'xshasa, -es qo'shiladi va yangi bo'g'in paydo bo'ladi.
Birlikdagi artikl ko'plikda ishlatilmaydi — o'rniga 'some' yoki hech narsa keladi.
Og'zaki nutqda 'Where is' doim qisqaradi. 'Where are' esa qisqarmaydi.
Javobda doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: IN va ON — qaysi so'z bilan qaysi predlog
wordFormation.explanationUz: Bu birikmalarni ALOHIDA emas, JUFTLIK holida yodlang.
Har biri o'z juftiga ega — juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.
Bu betdagi mashqlarda uchraydigan otlar.

wordFormation.ruleUz: have got / has got — inkor shakli
wordFormation.explanationUz: Unit 2 mavzusi, bu betda takrorlanadi.
Apostrof + s ikki butunlay boshqa narsani bildiradi. Kontekstdan farqlanadi.
Bu betda uchragan barcha 'an' talab qiladigan otlar.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Bir xil narsa, boshqa xona — boshqa so'z
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida narsa qaysi xonada turishiga qarab nomi o'zgaradi. Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q.
Fe'lga -er qo'shilsa, o'sha ishni bajaradigan narsa yoki odam nomi chiqadi.
Ba'zi otlar ingliz tilida hech qachon birlikda ishlatilmaydi.
Har bir sifat qaysi qo'shimcha bilan yasalganini bilsangiz, yozilishini adashtirmaysiz.
Bu birikmalarda predlog HECH QACHON almashmaydi — butun holda yodlanadi.

items.note: made FROM ham bor — material o'zgargan bo'lsa

wordFormation.explanationUz: Uy raqami borligiga qarab predlog o'zgaradi.
Ikkalasi ham 'qanchalik uzoq' haqida, lekin tuzilishi boshqa.

Shimol/janub so'zlari otdan sifatga o'tganda -ern qo'shimchasini oladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: IN the north OF ↔ ON the coast OF
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikkalasi ham joyni ko'rsatadi, lekin predloglari boshqa. Kalit so'zga qarang.

Har bir so'roq so'zi o'z javob turiga ega. Javobni bilsangiz, savolni topasiz.

Odam qanday his qilishini bildiruvchi sifatlar ko'pincha -ed bilan tugaydi.

BITTA narsa uchun. 'a/an' SHART.
O'zbekchada gap joy bilan boshlanadi, inglizchada esa 'There is' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: There ARE + some + KO'PLIK ot + in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the dining-room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqatlanish xonasida stullar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
KO'P narsa uchun. 'some' — aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda.
Ot KO'PLIKDA: chairs, cupboards (chair emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: The XONA is ON the ground/first floor.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oshxona birinchi qavatda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qavat uchun ON predlogi.
DIQQAT: 'ground floor' = o'zbekcha 1-qavat, 'first floor' = 2-qavat!

sentencePatterns.formula: The XONA is IN the attic. / OUTSIDE the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The study is in the attic. The garage is outside the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ish xonasi chordoqda. Garaj uydan tashqarida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Chordoq uchun IN (ichkarida), garaj uchun OUTSIDE (tashqarida).

sentencePatterns.formula: The house/flat HAS GOT + a/an + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The house has also got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyning yana chiroyli bog'i va basseyni bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'have got / has got' — egalikni bildiradi (Britan inglizchasi).
  I/you/we/they HAVE GOT
  he/she/it     HAS GOT
Uy va kvartira — 'it', shuning uchun HAS GOT.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is + quite/rather/very + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is quite expensive, but it is very large.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kuchaytiruvchilar:
  quite  — ancha (o'rtacha)
  rather — ancha (ko'pincha salbiy: 'rather small' — kichikroq ekan)
  very   — juda (eng kuchli)

sentencePatterns.formula: Upstairs / Downstairs, there is/are ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms. Downstairs, there is a huge kitchen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor. Past qavatda ulkan oshxona bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Joy so'zi gap BOSHIDA turishi mumkin, keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
Bu tavsifni tartibli qiladi: avval tepa, keyin past.

sentencePatterns.formula: a + xona + WITH + jihoz
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a bathroom with a shower and a toilet
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: dush va hojatxonali hammom
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' — 'bilan, ...li'. Xona ichida nima borligini qisqa aytadi.
O'zbekchada '-li' qo'shimchasi: kaminli, dushli, javonli.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is + masofa + FROM + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan yarim mil masofada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Masofa uchun FROM. Yaqinlik uchun NEAR:
  near the shops = do'konlarga yaqin (from yo'q!)

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a ... and that is a ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a sofa and that is a table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu divan, u esa stol.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala narsa ham BITTA. Yaqindagi — this, uzoqdagi — that.
Gap o'rtasida 'that' kichik harf bilan yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a ... and those are ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a desk and those are chairs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yozuv stoli, ular esa stullar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi bitta (this is a), ikkinchisi ko'p (those are + ko'plik ot).
DIQQAT: ko'plikda 'a' QO'YILMAYDI — those are chairs (a chairs emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a/an ... in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a bed in the bedroom.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yotoqxonada karavot bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik + tasdiq. 'a' yoki 'an' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are some ... in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the kitchen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oshxonada stullar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik + tasdiq. 'some' — 'bir nechta'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There isn't a/an ... / There aren't any ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There isn't an armchair. There aren't any posters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kreslo yo'q. Plakatlar yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkor. Ko'plikda 'some' emas, 'ANY' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is there a/an ...? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there a bed in the bedroom? — Yes, there is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yotoqxonada karavot bormi? — Ha, bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda 'Is' oldinga chiqadi. Qisqa javobda 'a bed' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any ...? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any chairs in the kitchen? — No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oshxonada stullar bormi? — Yo'q, yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik savol. 'any' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a ... BUT there isn't a ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat stoli bor, lekin kreslo yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' — 'lekin'. Ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni bitta gapga birlashtiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where is/are + ot? — It's / They're + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is the carpet? — It's on the floor.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gilam qayerda? — U polda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birlik: Where IS ...? → IT'S ...
Ko'plik: Where ARE ...? → THEY'RE ...
Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, olmosh ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a ... + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a ball under the table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stol ostida to'p bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval NIMA borligi, keyin QAYERDA ekani aytiladi.
O'zbekchada teskari: avval joy, keyin narsa.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any + ko'plik + predlog + joy? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any pictures on the wall? — Yes, there are. There are some pictures on the wall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devorda rasmlar bormi? — Ha, bor. Devorda rasmlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qisqa javobdan keyin TO'LIQ gapni ham aytish — kitobdagi namuna shunday.
Bu gapirish mashqida to'liq javob berishga o'rgatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... with a ... + predlog + it
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a bed with a pillow on it / a vase with some flowers in it
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ustida yostiq bor karavot / ichida gullar bor guldon
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' + narsa + predlog + 'it' — bitta narsani boshqasi bilan bog'lab tasvirlaydi.
'it' oldingi otga ishora qiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Behind/In front of + joy, there is/are ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Behind the bed there are two windows.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karavot orqasida ikkita deraza bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Predlogli ibora gap BOSHIDA ham turishi mumkin — tavsifni jonli qiladi.
Bunda 'there is/are' undan keyin keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody lives IN + qishloq/shahar/mamlakat/uy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Salif lives in a village in Nigeria. He lives in a mud hut.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salif Nigeriyadagi qishloqda yashaydi. U loy kulbada yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ichida bo'lgan, chegarasi bor joy uchun IN.
Qishloq, shahar, mamlakat, uy, kvartira — hammasi IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody lives ON + tog'/ferma/qayiq/qavat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Maria lives in a chalet on a mountain. Paul lives on a farm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mariya tog'dagi chaletda yashaydi. Pol fermada yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Yuza yoki maydon uchun ON: on a mountain, on a farm,
on a houseboat, on a river, on the fifteenth floor.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody lives AT + uy raqami, ko'cha.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives at 332, Newbury Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Nyuberi ko'chasi, 332-uyda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
To'liq manzil (uy raqami bilan) — AT.
Faqat ko'cha nomi bo'lsa — IN Newbury Street.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your address, please? — uy raqami, ko'cha, shahar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your address, please? — 14, Milcote Road, Birmingham.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Manzilingiz qanday? — Milkot yo'li, 14-uy, Birmingem.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'please' so'zi savolni muloyim qiladi — inglizchada juda muhim.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can you spell ... , please? — harflab aytish.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you spell the street name, please? — M-I-L-C-O-T-E.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'cha nomini harflab ayta olasizmi? — M-I-L-C-O-T-E.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'spell' — so'zni harflab aytmoq. Telefonda va rasmiy joylarda
doim so'raladi, chunki ingliz tilida yozilishi va o'qilishi farq qiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you got a telephone number? — Yes. It's + raqamlar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you got a telephone number? — Yes. It's 4204188.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Telefon raqamingiz bormi? — Ha. U 4204188.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Raqamlar birma-bir o'qiladi. 0 — 'oh', ikkita bir xil — 'double'.

sentencePatterns.formula: How many + ko'plik ot + has it got?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many rooms has it got?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nechta xonasi bor?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sanaladigan narsalar uchun 'How many'.
Pul va sanalmaydigan narsalar uchun 'How much': How much is it?

sentencePatterns.formula: This + sifat + uy turi + is + masofa/joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This lovely house is five miles from the city centre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan besh mil masofada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tasvirni shu qolip bilan boshlash — Enterprise'ning standart namunasi.
Masofa uchun FROM, yaqinlik uchun NEAR.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is + sifat, BUT it is + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is very expensive, but it is very large.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda qimmat, lekin juda katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'but' bilan ijobiy va salbiy tomonni bitta gapda beriladi.
Bu e'lon va tavsifda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Upstairs, there are ... Downstairs, there is ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Upstairs, there are four bedrooms. Downstairs, there is a spacious living-room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tepa qavatda to'rtta yotoqxona bor. Past qavatda keng mehmonxona bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qavat so'zi gap boshida, keyin vergul.
Tavsifni tartibli qiladi: avval tepa, keyin past, oxirida tashqari.

sentencePatterns.formula: Outside, it has got ... / The house has also got ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Outside, it has got a large garden and a double garage.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqarisida katta bog' va ikki mashinalik garaj bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'also' — 'yana, shuningdek'. 'has got' dan OLDIN, 'has' dan KEYIN turadi:
  The house HAS ALSO GOT a garden.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is a bargain at only £... per month.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is a bargain at only £300 per month.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyiga atigi 300 funt — bu juda arzon.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'only' — 'atigi, faqat'. Narxni arzon ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.
'at' — narx oldidan keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This/That is a + birlik ot. — These/Those are + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a clock. These are clocks. That is a rabbit. Those are rabbits.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu soat. Bular soatlar. U quyon. Ular quyonlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh, fe'l va ot — uchalasi ham birga o'zgaradi.
Bittasini o'zgartirib, boshqasini unutish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a + birlik ot + joy. / There are + son/some + ko'plik ot + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a desk in my room. There are five books on my desk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonamda yozuv stoli bor. Yozuv stolimda beshta kitob bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Aniq son bo'lsa 'some' kerak emas: 'There are FIVE books' (some emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: Is there a ...? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there a sofa in the living-room? — Yes, there is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mehmonxonada divan bormi? — Ha, bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda 'there' saqlanadi, ot takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any ...? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any chairs in the room? — No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonada stullar bormi? — Yo'q, yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik savolda 'any' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: There isn't a/an + birlik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There isn't an elephant in the zoo.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hayvonot bog'ida fil yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkor gap, lekin ot birlik — shuning uchun 'any' emas, 'an'.

sentencePatterns.formula: ot + is/are + predlog + the + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The cat is on the fence. The dog is in the kennel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushuk devor ustida. It kataksida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Predlogdan keyin odatda 'the' keladi — chunki qaysi joy ekani ma'lum.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a/an X and these are Xs.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is an apple and these are apples.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu olma, bular esa olmalar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yaqindagi narsa. Uch narsa birga o'zgaradi: this→these, is→are, X→Xs.

sentencePatterns.formula: That is a X and those are Xs.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That is a pencil and those are pencils.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qalam, ular esa qalamlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uzoqdagi narsa. Xuddi shunday uchta o'zgarish.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a X and this is a Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a table and this is a lamp.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu stol, bu esa chiroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkala narsa ham BITTA va yaqin. 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a X → There are some Xs.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a lamp in the room. → There are some lamps in the room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonada chiroq bor. → Xonada chiroqlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ko'plikka o'tganda: is→are, a→some, X→Xs.
Joy qismi ('in the room') o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where's + birlik? — He's/She's/It's + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where's Mary? — She's in the study.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meri qayerda? — U ish xonasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birlik uchun Where's. Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, olmosh ishlatiladi:
erkak → He's, ayol → She's, narsa → It's.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where are + ko'plik? — They're + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are my books? — They're on the table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kitoblarim qayerda? — Ular stolda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik uchun Where are. Javob doim They're.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is/are ... BUT there isn't/aren't ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some pictures on the walls but there aren't any posters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devorlarda rasmlar bor, lekin plakatlar yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'but' bilan bor va yo'q narsani bitta gapda taqqoslash.
Tasdiqda 'some', inkorda 'any'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a X. It is + predlog + Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a chair in the room. It is in front of the desk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonada stul bor. U yozuv stolining oldida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval NIMA borligi, keyin alohida gapda QAYERDA ekani.
Ikkinchi gapda ot o'rniga 'It' keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is/isn't + a/an + birlik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There isn't a bedroom downstairs. There's an armchair in the living-room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Past qavatda yotoqxona yo'q. Mehmonxonada kreslo bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birlik otda inkor bo'lsa ham 'any' EMAS, 'a/an' ishlatiladi.
Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + some + ko'plik ot. / There aren't + any + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some plants in the garden. There aren't any drawings on the wall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog'da o'simliklar bor. Devorda chizmalar yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: some — tasdiq, any — inkor va savol. Faqat ko'plik bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any + ko'plik ot ...? / Have you got any ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any flats for rent in the area? Have you got any apples?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hududda ijaraga beriladigan kvartiralar bormi? Sizda olma bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'any' faqat 'there is/are' bilan emas, 'have got' bilan ham ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This/That + IS + birlik. / These/Those + ARE + ko'plik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is my bicycle. Those are pencils. These are rabbits.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mening velosipedim. Ular qalamlar. Bular quyonlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh, fe'l va ot — uchalasi bir vaqtda o'zgaradi.
Xatolarni tuzatish mashqidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan muammo shu.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where is he from? — He's from China.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is he from? I am from China.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qayerdan? — Men Xitoydanman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kelib chiqishni so'rash: 'Where ... from?' — 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Unit 1 mavzusi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where's the X? — It's in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where's the desk? — It's in the study.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yozuv stoli qayerda? — U ish xonasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik. Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi — 'It' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where are the X? — They're in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are the chairs? — They're in the dining-room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stullar qayerda? — Ular ovqatlanish xonasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik. 'They're' = They are.

sentencePatterns.formula: The flat/house HAS GOT + a + sifat + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The flat has got a wonderful view.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kvartiraning ajoyib manzarasi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Artikl SIFATDAN OLDIN turadi: a wonderful view (wonderful a view EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a + sifat + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a double garage.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ikki mashinalik garaj bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tartib: There is + a + sifat + ot.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... with a + sifat + ot
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a balcony with a lovely view / a garden with a large swimming-pool
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: go'zal manzarali balkon / katta basseynli bog'
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'with' qo'shimcha xususiyatni qo'shadi. O'zbekchada '-li' qo'shimchasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The cat is + predlog + the basket.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The cat is near the basket. The cat is in the basket.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushuk savat yonida. Mushuk savat ichida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Eng sodda predlog qolipi. Narsalar bir xil, faqat predlog o'zgaradi —
shuning uchun farqni yaxshi sezasiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody lives IN/ON/AT + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I live in a small flat on the fourth floor. She lives at 25, Momon Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men to'rtinchi qavatdagi kichik kvartirada yashayman. U Momon ko'chasi, 25-uyda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda ikki predlog ham bo'lishi mumkin: IN (kvartira) + ON (qavat).

sentencePatterns.formula: There is/are + a/an/some/any + ot + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a rug under the table. There are some books on the table.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stol ostida gilamcha bor. Stol ustida kitoblar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: To'liq qolip: fe'l + aniqlovchi + ot + predlog + joy.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where's/Where are ...? — He's/She's/It's/They're + predlog + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where's John? — He's at school. Where are your books? — They're in my bag.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon qayerda? — U maktabda. Kitoblaring qayerda? — Ular sumkamda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Egalik olmoshi bilan 'the' ishlatilmaydi: 'in MY bag' (in the my bag EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: X is made of + material.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Chalets are made of wood.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chaletlar yog'ochdan yasalgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bilan 'are made of'. Birlik bilan 'is made of'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is there a X in the room? — Yes, there is. It's + predlog + Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there a table in the room? — Yes, there is. It's in front of the fireplace.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonada stol bormi? — Ha, bor. U kaminning oldida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki bosqichli suhbat: avval BORMI, keyin QAYERDA.
Birinchi javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, ikkinchisida 'It' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any X? — Yes, there are. They're + predlog + Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any cushions in the room? — Yes, there are. They're on the sofa.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xonada yostiqchalar bormi? — Ha, bor. Ular divanda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik varianti: any + Are there + They're.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is IN the north/south OF + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Milan is in the north of Italy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Milan Italiyaning shimolida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Mamlakat ichidagi qism uchun IN. 'of' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is ON the ... coast OF + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Southampton is on the south coast of England.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sautgempton Angliyaning janubiy qirg'og'ida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'coast' so'zi bo'lsa — doim ON.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a X and these are Xs. / That is a X and those are Xs.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a car and these are cars. That is a balloon and those are balloons.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mashina, bular esa mashinalar. U shar, ular esa sharlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Yaqin — this/these, uzoq — that/those.
Uchta o'zgarish: olmosh + fe'l + ot.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can you deliver/spell ... , please? — muloyim so'rov.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you deliver the bicycle to my house? Can you spell the street name, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Velosipedni uyimga yetkazib bera olasizmi? Ko'cha nomini harflab ayta olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Can you ...?' — muloyim so'rov. 'please' oxirida vergul bilan ajratiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's it like? — It's a + sifat + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's it like? — It's a big house and it's not very expensive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanaqa? — U katta uy va unchalik qimmat emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tavsif so'rash. 'like' bu yerda 'kabi' ma'nosida — 'nimaga o'xshaydi?'

sentencePatterns.formula: How much is it? — It's only £... per month.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How much is it? — It's only £500 per month.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Narxi qancha? — Atigi oyiga 500 funt.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Pul sanalmaydi, shuning uchun 'How much'. 'only' narxni arzon ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is/are ... AT THE FRONT / AT THE BACK of the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a small garden at the front of the house and a larger garden at the back.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyning oldida kichik bog', orqasida esa kattaroq bog' bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'at the front of' — old tomonida, 'at the back' — orqa tomonida.
'larger' — 'large' ning qiyosiy shakli (kattaroq).

sentencePatterns.formula: X makes me feel + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It makes me feel safe and relaxed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U meni xavfsiz va xotirjam his qildiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'make somebody feel ...' — 'kimnidir ... his qildirmoq'.
'feel' dan keyin TO ishlatilmaydi: makes me FEEL (to feel EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: I love ... BECAUSE ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My favourite room is the study because there is a big bookcase there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eng yoqtirgan xonam — ish xonasi, chunki u yerda katta kitob javoni bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' — fikrni asoslash. Insho va gapirishda baho oshiradi:
faqat 'I like it' emas, NEGA yoqtirishingizni ayting.

sentencePatterns.formula: At last, ... / After all, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At last, Rachel and I are in our new home. After all, home is where the heart is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nihoyat, Reychel va men yangi uyimizdamiz. Axir, uy — qalb qayerda bo'lsa, o'sha yer.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'At last' — uzoq kutishdan keyin (nihoyat).
'After all' — xulosa qilganda (axir, oxir-oqibat).
Ikkalasidan keyin ham VERGUL qo'yiladi.
